layer_3_action.action: A composed, non-aggressive young Stegoceras with clean high-poly clay geometry is standing completely still in a poised, upright bipedal posture adjacent to a stylized Late Cretaceous ginkgo tree. The camera frames a stable three-quarter profile from a straight eye-level view, dramatically accentuating its narrow egg-shaped dome, its prominent tiara-like ring of back spikes, and its graceful, slender bird-like neck line to instantly signal its lightweight, agile silhouette. It looks forward with quiet curiosity over a soft marsh bank under soft, cinematic studio ambient occlusion lighting. No text.
